source.author: verg
source.text: Optuma quaeque dies miseris mortalibus aevi prima fugit; subeunt morbi tristisque senectus et labor, et durae rapit inclementia mortis.
source.text_original: Optuma quaeque dies miseris mortalibus aevi / prima fugit; subeunt morbi tristisque senectus / et labor, et durae rapit inclementia mortis.
source.text_english: The best days of life are the first to flee from wretched mortals; diseases, sad old age, and toil come on, and the harsh severity of death carries them off.
